sources.sql:
CREATE TABLE "comments" (
  "Id" INTEGER,
  "PostId" INTEGER,
  "Score" INTEGER,
  "Text" TEXT,
  "CreationDate" DATETIME,
  "UserId" INTEGER,
  "UserDisplayName" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE "PostDetails" (
  "Id" INTEGER,
  "PostTypeId" INTEGER,
  "AcceptedAnswerId" INTEGER,
  "CreaionDate" DATETIME,
  "Score" INTEGER,
  "ViewCount" INTEGER,
  "Body" TEXT,
  "AnswerCount" INTEGER,
  "CommentCount" INTEGER,
  "FavoriteCount" INTEGER,
  "Tags" TEXT,
  "Title" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE "postHistory" (
  "Id" INTEGER,
  "PostHistoryTypeId" INTEGER,
  "PostId" INTEGER,
  "RevisionGUID" TEXT,
  "CreationDate" DATETIME,
  "UserId" INTEGER,
  "Text" TEXT,
  "Comment" TEXT,
  "UserDisplayName" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE "postLinks" (
  "Id" INTEGER,
  "CreationDate" DATETIME,
  "PostId" INTEGER,
  "RelatedPostId" INTEGER,
  "LinkTypeId" INTEGER
);

CREATE TABLE "tags" (
  "Id" INTEGER,
  "TagName" TEXT,
  "Count" INTEGER,
  "ExcerptPostId" INTEGER,
  "WikiPostId" INTEGER
);

CREATE TABLE "UserActivity" (
  "Id" INTEGER,
  "OwnerUserId" INTEGER,
  "LasActivityDate" DATETIME,
  "LastEditorUserId" INTEGER,
  "LastEditDate" DATETIME,
  "OwnerDisplayName" TEXT,
  "LastEditorDisplayName" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE "users" (
  "Id" INTEGER,
  "Reputation" INTEGER,
  "CreationDate" DATETIME,
  "DisplayName" TEXT,
  "LastAccessDate" DATETIME,
  "WebsiteUrl" TEXT,
  "Location" TEXT,
  "AboutMe" TEXT,
  "Views" INTEGER,
  "UpVotes" INTEGER,
  "DownVotes" INTEGER,
  "AccountId" INTEGER,
  "Age" INTEGER,
  "ProfileImageUrl" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE "votes" (
  "Id" INTEGER,
  "PostId" INTEGER,
  "VoteTypeId" INTEGER,
  "CreationDate" DATE,
  "UserId" INTEGER,
  "BountyAmount" INTEGER
);
